query: .tables ; .schema
result: 10 tables: superhero, hero_attribute, hero_power, attribute, superpower, gender, alignment, race, colour, publisher. superhero holds the descriptive columns (superhero_name, full_name, gender_id, eye_colour_id, hair_colour_id, skin_colour_id, race_id, publisher_id, alignment_id, height_cm, weight_kg). hero_attribute(hero_id, attribute_id, attribute_value) and hero_power(hero_id, power_id) are many-to-many link tables.

query: SELECT 'gender',COUNT(*) FROM gender UNION ALL SELECT 'alignment',COUNT(*) FROM alignment UNION ALL SELECT 'attribute',COUNT(*) FROM attribute UNION ALL SELECT 'colour',COUNT(*) FROM colour UNION ALL SELECT 'publisher',COUNT(*) FROM publisher UNION ALL SELECT 'race',COUNT(*) FROM race UNION ALL SELECT 'superhero',COUNT(*) FROM superhero UNION ALL SELECT 'superpower',COUNT(*) FROM superpower UNION ALL SELECT 'hero_attribute',COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute UNION ALL SELECT 'hero_power',COUNT(*) FROM hero_power

query: SELECT * FROM gender
result: 1=Male, 2=Female, 3=N/A

query: SELECT s.gender_id, g.gender, COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg),2), ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm),2) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON g.id=s.gender_id GROUP BY s.gender_id
result: Male 519 heroes (avg weight 19213.70, avg height 292.56); Female 203 heroes (avg weight 60.78, avg height 169.45); N/A 28 heroes (avg weight 3600068.96, avg height 526.80)

query: SELECT * FROM alignment
result: 1=Good, 2=Bad, 3=Neutral, 4=N/A

query: SELECT * FROM attribute
result: 1=Intelligence, 2=Strength, 3=Speed, 4=Durability, 5=Power, 6=Combat

query: SELECT ha.attribute_id, a.attribute_name, MIN(ha.attribute_value), MAX(ha.attribute_value), ROUND(AVG(ha.attribute_value),2), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON a.id=ha.attribute_id GROUP BY ha.attribute_id
result: Intelligence 35-100 (avg 84.33); Strength 5-100 (avg 47.24); Speed 5-100; Durability 5-100; Power 5-100; Combat 5-100; each attribute recorded for 623 superheroes across 623 rows

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id), COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id||'-'||attribute_id), SUM(attribute_value IS NULL) FROM hero_attribute
result: 3738 rows, 623 distinct heroes, 3738 distinct (hero, attribute) pairs, 0 NULL values

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id), COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id||'-'||power_id), SUM(power_id IS NULL) FROM hero_power
result: 5825 rows, 652 distinct heroes, 5825 distinct (hero, power) pairs, 0 NULL values

query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero) total, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) FROM hero_attribute) with_attributes, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) FROM hero_power) with_powers
result: 750 total superheroes; 623 have attribute ratings; 652 have superpowers

query: SELECT ha.attribute_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) FROM hero_attribute ha WHERE ha.attribute_id=(SELECT id FROM attribute WHERE attribute_name='Strength') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 5
result: value 100 held by 63 superheroes; 95 by 17; 90 by 16; 85 by 44; 80 by 34

query: SELECT * FROM colour
result: 35 values; id 1='No Colour', id 14='Green'; also Black, Blue, Brown, Red, White, Yellow and compound values such as 'Red/White'

query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT eye_colour_id), COUNT(DISTINCT skin_colour_id), COUNT(DISTINCT hair_colour_id), SUM(eye_colour_id IS NULL), SUM(skin_colour_id IS NULL), SUM(hair_colour_id IS NULL) FROM superhero
result: 21 distinct eye colours, 16 distinct skin colours, 26 distinct hair colours used; 0 NULL values in all three colour foreign keys

query: SELECT c.colour, COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON c.id=s.eye_colour_id WHERE c.colour IN ('No Colour','Green') GROUP BY 1
result: 169 superheroes have eye colour 'No Colour'; 76 have eye colour 'Green'

query: SELECT c.colour, al.alignment, COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON c.id=s.skin_colour_id JOIN alignment al ON al.id=s.alignment_id WHERE c.colour='Green' GROUP BY 1,2
result: 21 superheroes have skin colour Green: 14 Good, 6 Bad, 1 Neutral

query: SELECT MIN(height_cm), MAX(height_cm), MIN(weight_kg), MAX(weight_kg), SUM(height_cm IS NULL), SUM(weight_kg IS NULL) FROM superhero; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE height_cm=0; SELECT superhero_name, height_cm, weight_kg FROM superhero ORDER BY height_cm DESC LIMIT 5
result: height_cm spans 0-30480 with 58 NULLs and 155 zeros; weight_kg spans 0-90000000 with 64 NULLs. Largest rows: Surtur 30480/0, Ymir 30480/0, Godzilla 10800/90000000, Giganta 6250/630, Bloodwraith 3050/0; heaviest also King Kong 3050/9000000 (largest 90000000) and Utgard-Loki 1520/58000

query: SELECT SUM(height_cm IS NULL), SUM(weight_kg IS NULL), SUM(height_cm=0) FROM superhero

query: SELECT p.publisher_name, COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute ha WHERE ha.hero_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM superhero)), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.hero_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM superhero)), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.power_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM superpower)), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s WHERE s.publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND s.publisher_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM publisher))
result: 0 orphan rows in all four checks: the identifiers in the link tables share the value domain of the superhero primary key
